message: M&A deck cover: Kering acquiring Moncler, Catolica Lisbon Investment Partners.
layout_trick: Full-bleed alpine mountain photo with both brand logos floating over the sky and tiny deck-type tag bottom-right; photo metaphor ties to Moncler's outerwear origin.

message: Kering should launch a public tender for 100% of Moncler at EUR64.63/share (20% premium, ~EUR17.5bn), 45% cash / 50% debt / 5% stock, DCF range EUR50-65.
layout_trick: Exec summary as 6 label/text rows (Proposed Transaction, Price/Premium, Rationale, Synergies, Valuation, Recommendation) separated by hairlines, small-caps labels in left column, zero charts.

message: Luxury market grew from 2008 to 2025 at ~4.9% CAGR but post-pandemic boom is over; growth now price-driven, volume lost ~80M consumers.
layout_trick: Bar series segmented by dashed vertical dividers labelled with market phases (Crisis, Chinese acceleration, Covid...) plus CAGR arrow, paired with an event timeline and 3 big-number stat strips below.

message: Kering has structurally underperformed luxury peers over 5 years, not cyclically.
layout_trick: Indexed share-price line chart over a logo-header returns table (L1M to 5Y) with peer logos as column headers and green/red coloured numbers.

message: Specialist luxury brands win the recovery while generalists (Gucci, Kering) struggle; 9 of 15 top brands changed creative director.
layout_trick: Bar chart with green 'Specialists' and red 'Generalists' shaded zones, next to a wordmark-logo list showing outgoing to incoming creative director with dotted arrows.

message: Structural attractiveness is intact but growth is more selective: Asia and Middle East lead, and Moncler's category (apparel/footwear) outgrows Kering's leather goods.
layout_trick: Four-panel dashboard: two small bar charts, bubble-on-map with % growth, and category bars with Moncler core category and Kering main exposure highlighted in gold boxes.

message: Kering is a multi-brand luxury platform at an inflection point, with EBIT margin down from 28.5% to 11.1% since 2021.
layout_trick: Dense at-a-glance page: description + shareholder tree, brand logo grid, board/management table, key financials table with the EBIT margin row boxed in a coloured frame, and revenue-by-brand bars.

message: Kering has three structural vulnerabilities (Gucci concentration, China misalignment, leather goods exposure), not one cyclical problem.
layout_trick: Regional bubble map plus a treemap of revenue by category with a gold call-out box beside it, and Gucci vs group ROI bars with overlaid line.

message: Gucci's turnaround is under way (new creative director, CEO changes) but commercial impact is not expected before 2027, and past luxury resets took 3-4 years.
layout_trick: Horizontal milestone timeline with labels alternating above and below the axis, over a bar comparison of prior brand turnarounds with a gold conclusion box.

message: Moncler is a focused two-brand luxury specialist (Moncler and Stone Island) with 29% EBIT margin and continuity of management.
layout_trick: Same 3-column business overview template as the Kering page, so target and acquirer read as a matched pair; key-financials EBIT margin row highlighted in green frame.

message: Moncler gained Asian share (52% of revenue) even while the regional market declined, outperforming LVMH, Gucci and YSL exposure.
layout_trick: Two world maps with bubble sizes per region (Moncler, Stone Island) beside paired 2024/2025 bars per peer, with the Moncler column framed in gold.

message: Moncler holds a category moat: no scaled competitor sits at the intersection of luxury and technical outerwear.
layout_trick: Positioning map with brand logos placed on an accessible-to-ultra-luxury axis and fashion-to-specialist axis, Moncler/Stone Island/Canada Goose alone in the empty corner, with a bold callout and 5 benefit bullets on the right.

message: Moncler sustained ~29% EBIT margin while the industry fell to 15-16%, with growing net cash and stable FCF.
layout_trick: Left line chart of peer EBIT margins with Moncler highlighted; right stack of cash/debt back-to-back bars and FCF bars, 3 panels with section headers and rule lines.

message: Moncler addresses each of six structural weaknesses in Kering's portfolio.
layout_trick: Weakness-to-solution table with red/amber traffic-light circle icons in the first column and a dark header row; columns Why it matters, Moncler solution, Strategic implication.

message: Football field across seven methodologies supports a ~20% premium, with offer EUR64.63 above the analyst and DCF ranges.
layout_trick: Football field integrated into a table: each row has method name, floating bar with low/high labels, implied FV low/high and a comment column, with a shaded vertical band for the offer range.

message: The transaction is accretive and value-creative: offer price vs standalone upside plus strategic premium, with EPS accretion growing to FY2030.
layout_trick: Price build-up bars (share price, standalone upside, fair price, strategic premium boxed, target price) next to paired EPS Kering vs pro forma bars with accretion line.

message: Revenue synergies of EUR38M and cost synergies of EUR69M by FY2030 are phased in conservatively.
layout_trick: Mirrored twin panels (revenue vs cost synergies), each with annual bars, accumulated line, a gold assumption box and a mini-table of standalone vs post-synergy figures underneath.

message: Combined group is more balanced and more profitable: EUR18.3bn revenue, 15.8% EBIT margin and EUR5.5bn EBITDA pro forma.
layout_trick: Before/after donuts with arrow showing brand mix shift, small multiples bars for revenue/margins/FCF, and a pro-forma bridge table with columns Kering, Moncler, adjustments, pro forma.

message: Governance design must preserve Ruffini's alignment and Moncler's brand independence via a 10-member board and take-private ownership structure.
layout_trick: Boardroom drawn as a round table with chair icons around it labelled per director, next to an ownership org chart (Kering to Moncler to Stone Island) and pre/post-deal shareholder table.

message: Financing is structured within investment-grade limits: leverage peaks at 2.9x ND/EBITDA and delevers to 1.4x by FY2030, below the 3.0x BBB+ threshold.
layout_trick: Sources and Uses ledger on the left and a credit profile table plus area chart of ND/EBITDA with a gold dashed S&P threshold line on the right.

message: All six risks are manageable, but two (Ruffini governance, LVMH minority stake) require pre-closing resolution.
layout_trick: Probability x impact heat grid with numbered coloured bubbles (red, amber, green) and a shaded 'pre-closing' zone, matched by a numbered table of risk, probability, impact, mitigation and residual risk.

message: Recommend acquiring Moncler now: right asset, executable and accretive financially, and timing will not improve; subject to four pre-announcement conditions.
layout_trick: Three stacked boxes linked by a vertical connector on the left (strategic, financial, timing) plus a dark callout box, and a numbered conditions list on the right with gold titles.

message: Table of contents with seven sections and page numbers.
layout_trick: Gold left accent bar on each entry and dotted leaders to right-aligned page numbers; the same section list is repeated as a footer breadcrumb with the current section highlighted in gold on every content slide.
